oriel_host.text: Croeso to Oriel y Parc. Oriel means gallery and parc means park, so you are in the Park Gallery. Handy.
This is the visitor centre for the Pembrokeshire Coast National Park, made a park in 1952. It is Britain's only national park that is mostly coast.
Upstairs there is art from the National Museum Wales collection, picked to show you the landscape you have been walking through.

oriel_ranger.text: Watch the cliffs for choughs. Real ones have red legs and a red beak. The Cragchough you can find on the cliffs is a rather bigger cousin.
